crossRefs.note: Esther had not made known her people nor her relatives, because Mordecai had instructed her that she should not make it…
Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

people.name: Mordecai
people.line: Esther's cousin, a Jewish leader in the Persian court.

translations.web: Esther had not yet made known her relatives nor her people, as Mordecai had commanded her; for Esther obeyed Mordecai, like she did when she was brought up by him.
translations.bsb: Esther still had not revealed her lineage or her people, just as Mordecai had instructed. She obeyed Mordecai’s command, as she had done under his care.
translations.kjv: Esther had not yet shewed her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up
translations.asv: Esther had not yet made known her kindred nor her people; as Mordecai had charged her: for Esther did the commandment of Mordecai, like as when she was brought up with him.
